So, the mean, or typical value for this data set is 82. That suggests that the “average grade” on this
exam was an 82. As you look at the data, there were three scores right around the mean, the 80, 82,
and 83. There was one score that was higher, and one that was lower. In this sense, the mean is
doing a good job of finding the center of the data. If we look at the dot plot of the data in
we can see that the value 82 is right in the middle.
